title: Protesters March in Kargil in Solidarity with LAB Leadership

ai.summary: Ladakh MPs and Kargil Democratic Alliance leaders marched in Kargil to support Leh Apex Body's demand for postponing December 4 hill council elections due to winter conditions and seasonal migration, following activist Sonam Wangchuk's house arrest.

facts.claim: Kargil- Ladakh MP Hanifa Jan, along with leaders of the Kargil Democratic Alliance (KDA), led a march here to express solidarity with the Leh Apex Body (LAB), including its member Sonam Wangchuk, over their demand for the deferment of the December 4 hill council elections.
facts.quote: Kargil- Ladakh MP Hanifa Jan, along with leaders of the Kargil Democratic Alliance (KDA), led a march here to express solidarity with the Leh Apex Body (LAB), including its member Sonam Wangchuk, over their demand for the deferment of the December 4 hill council elections.

facts.claim: A day after police removed activist Wangchuk from a protest site in Leh and escorted him to his residence, the activist on Thursday claimed that he had been placed under house arrest.
facts.quote: A day after police removed activist Wangchuk from a protest site in Leh and escorted him to his residence, the activist on Thursday claimed that he had been placed under house arrest.

facts.claim: LAB and KDA have expressed resentment over the holding of hill council elections on December 4, citing harsh winter conditions and large-scale seasonal migration.
facts.quote: LAB and KDA have expressed resentment over the holding of hill council elections on December 4, citing harsh winter conditions and large-scale seasonal migration.

facts.claim: Holding candles, the protesters held a “Save Democracy” march in Kargil district headquarters on Saturday.
facts.quote: Holding candles, the protesters held a “Save Democracy” march in Kargil district headquarters on Saturday.

facts.claim: MP Hanifa Jan, along with KDA leaders including its co-chairmen Asgar Ali Karbalai and Sajjad Kargili, led the march with protesters chanting slogans in support of the demand for Wangchuk’s “release”.
facts.quote: MP Hanifa Jan, along with KDA leaders including its co-chairmen Asgar Ali Karbalai and Sajjad Kargili, led the march with protesters chanting slogans in support of the demand for Wangchuk’s “release”.

facts.claim: They extended solidarity to the people who have been holding protests under the banner of LAB for the past three days, seeking postponement of polls.
facts.quote: They extended solidarity to the people who have been holding protests under the banner of LAB for the past three days, seeking postponement of polls.

facts.claim: LAB and KDA have been jointly engaged in a struggle for several years over the statehood issue and have been holding dialogue with the central government in support of an elected government and constitutional safeguards.
facts.quote: LAB and KDA have been jointly engaged in a struggle for several years over the statehood issue and have been holding dialogue with the central government in support of an elected government and constitutional safeguards.

facts.claim: Leh Apex Body has launched a sit-in protest in Leh over its six-point agenda…We are holding this march in Kargil in support of the agitation and to condemn the house arrest of Wangchuk, which is seen as an attempt to silence dissent,” the Ladakh MP told PTI.
facts.quote: Leh Apex Body has launched a sit-in protest in Leh over its six-point agenda…We are holding this march in Kargil in support of the agitation and to condemn the house arrest of Wangchuk, which is seen as an attempt to silence dissent,” the Ladakh MP told PTI.

facts.claim: For the past six years, he said the LAB and KDA have been struggling for democratic rights and constitutional safeguards in Ladakh.
facts.quote: For the past six years, he said the LAB and KDA have been struggling for democratic rights and constitutional safeguards in Ladakh.

facts.claim: Despite repeated protests, demonstrations and discussions, little progress has been made, Jan said and alleged that decisions concerning elections and delimitation were being imposed by the Lt Governor administration without consulting the people, prompting widespread resentment across the region.
facts.quote: Despite repeated protests, demonstrations and discussions, little progress has been made, Jan said and alleged that decisions concerning elections and delimitation were being imposed by the Lt Governor administration without consulting the people, prompting widespread resentment across the region.

facts.claim: We urge the government and UT administration to take cognisance of the growing public anger, restore democracy in Ladakh in accordance with the people’s aspirations, and respect their democratic rights. Otherwise, this agitation will spread to every corner of Ladakh,” the MP said.
facts.quote: We urge the government and UT administration to take cognisance of the growing public anger, restore democracy in Ladakh in accordance with the people’s aspirations, and respect their democratic rights. Otherwise, this agitation will spread to every corner of Ladakh,” the MP said.

ai.background_note: LAB and KDA have been advocating for Ladakh statehood since 2019, following the loss of statehood when it was split into two union territories. The current protest focuses on delaying elections due to winter conditions and seasonal migration, with demands for democratic rights and constitutional safeguards.
